violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child
violation_type.typical_finding: A caregiver served a child in care food they had an identified allergy to, resulting in the child having an   allergic reaction.

finding_variants.text: A caregiver served a child in care food they had an identified allergy to, resulting in the child having an   allergic reaction.
This standard was found to be deficient. A new caregiver gave an allergic food item to a child.
Based on the evidence gathered, a child was given an item listed on their allergy action plan.
A child was given a food that he has a diagnosed allergy to.
Based on the evidence gathered during the investigation, a caregiver served food to a child that was identified as an allergen.
A food that a child was known to be allergic to was served to that child.
